ruleDefinitions.name: Flash Player Update from Suspicious Location
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects a flashplayer update from an unofficial location Note: Unmapped fields: c-uri, cs-host

sequences.query: (c-uri = RGX(".*\\/flash\\_install\\\.php.*") OR c-uri = RGX("\\/install\\_flash\\_player\\\.exe$")) AND  NOT (cs-host = RGX("\\\.adobe\\\.com$"))
